# Stumble Agent Guide

Stumble is a headless personal discovery system using protocol `stumble/1.0`.
Agent Harnesses own external browser, search, API, credential, and scheduler
access. Stumble never crawls or controls a browser.

Use scoped Harness Grants. Read `/pods/:slug/package`, claim work through
`/discovery-tasks`, submit structured provenance through `/candidates`, and
retrieve finite presentation-neutral batches through `/feed`. Record only
explicit Feedback Signals. Never export tokens, grants, Candidates, Taste
Profiles, feedback, Saves, or Feed history.

Legacy crawler, source-connector, direct link submission, in-node discovery,
and brief endpoints are retired and return a versioned compatibility error.
